message.content:
Based on the provided screenshot of the **TopBid.uz** mobile app (390px viewport), here is the strict evaluation of the Ranking Cards area:

### 1) Card Structure & Alignment
*   **Rank Number:** Positioned correctly at the top-right of each card. No overlap with the name or avatar.
*   **Avatar, Name & Description:** The circular avatar is on the left, name is bold and aligned to its right, and the description follows below. No misalignment detected.
*   **Chips (Tags):** Category chips (e.g., "Ingliz tili", "Toshkent") are correctly placed below the description.
*   **Stats Line:** Icons for rating, views, and time since posting are aligned to the left.
*   **Price:** Aligned to the far right on the same line as the stats. This creates a consistent visual baseline across all visible cards.
*   **CTA Button:** A full-width button at the bottom containing the price and discount badge.
*   **Defect/Overlap:** There is a **floating "N" badge** (likely a "New" or navigation indicator) in the bottom-left corner that overlaps the avatar and rating icon of the 4th card ("English House Buxoro"). This appears to be a UI glitch or an improperly positioned floating action button.

### 2) TOP-3 Cards (Visual Distinction)
*   **Observation:** The first card (Rank #1, partially cut off at the top) has a distinct **orange/gold border** surrounding it.
*   **Defect:** Cards ranked **#4, #5, and #6** do *not* have this special border or a "Top-3" style treatment. If the design intent was to highlight only the absolute top 3, this is working as intended. However, if Rank #4 was meant to be included in a "Premium" tier, it is missing that styling.

### 3) Text Truncation
*   **Description:**
    *   Card #5 (**Nur Afzal Ta'lim Markazi**): The description text ends with an ellipsis (`...`), indicating it has been correctly truncated to fit two lines.
    *   Other cards appear to fit their text without truncation or use standard line breaks.
*   **Category Chips:** All chips ("Ingliz tili (IELTS)", "Matematika", etc.) are fully visible and not clipped.
*   **Name:** All names ("Aziza Karimova", etc.) are fully visible on one line.

### 4) CTA Button Visibility
*   **Status:** The CTA button text **"O'rinni egallash dan XX XXX so'm"** is fully visible in a single line in all cards.
*   **Layout:** The text, price, and "-50%" orange badge are contained within the button's padding. There is no wrapping or clipping of the button content.

### 5) Price Alignment
*   **Consistency:** Yes, the prices (**75 000 so'm**, **65 000 so'm**, **50 000 so'm**) are perfectly right-aligned relative to the stats icons above them. They form a clean vertical axis down the list.

### 6) Spacing & Edge Proximity
*   **Internal Padding:** The spacing between elements (avatar-to-name, name-to-description, etc.) looks comfortable and consistent.
*   **Card Edges:** No internal text or icons are touching the card borders. The padding is sufficient.
*   **External Spacing:** There is clear vertical whitespace (gap) separating each card.

---

### Summary of Defects Found:
1.  **Floating Element Overlap:** A dark circular badge with the letter **"N"** is overlapping the bottom-left corner of the last visible card ("English House Buxoro"), obscuring part of the avatar and the star-rating icon.
2.  **Missing Top-Tier Styling (Potential):** If ranks 1-3 are meant to be visually grouped, rank #4 lacks the gold border seen on rank #1 (though this may be intentional to distinguish the podium).
